description: List the flight alerts configured on your AeroAPI account — the flights you are watching. Requires a Standard or Premium AeroAPI tier (the free Personal tier returns 401).

cursor.description: Paging cursor: the cursor query parameter of a previous response's links.next (passing the whole links.next value also works)

max_pages.description: Max pages to fetch, 1-20 (AeroAPI default: 1). Capped at 20 since AeroAPI bills per page.

view.description: Response shape. "compact" (default) strips image/avatar URLs from the response; "full" returns FlightAware's payload untouched; "brief" returns one line per alert, "ident route — <start date or no date> — <active|active until …|expired …|paused>", inside the untrusted-data envelope, with "-- none" for no alerts and "-- more" when another page exists.

name: fa_list_alerts
